dataset.title: OFAC UAE Case
dataset.text: The US Department of the Treasury's OFAC announced sanctions against Alexey Shevchenko, a Russian procurement agent operating in Dubai, for illegally shipping military drone components from United States manufacturers to Russia through UAE-based front companies including Al-Sahra Electronics.

dataset.title: DOJ HSBC Case
dataset.text: Assistant Attorney General Kenneth A. Polite Jr. announced that Stephen Murphy, a former executive at HSBC, pleaded guilty in New York federal court for his role in laundering $50 million of illicit drug proceeds linked to the Sinaloa Cartel through shadow accounts.

dataset.title: EU Sanctions Belarus
dataset.text: The European Council expanded restrictive measures against Belarus, blacklisting Dmitry Kovalev, the CEO of Belneftekhim, for facilitating industrial exports to state-owned Russian defense firms in violation of EU embargoes.

dataset.title: SFC Hong Kong AML
dataset.text: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) fined broker-dealer Sun Hung Kai Securities $1.2 million following an investigation into systemic anti-money laundering compliance failures overseen by compliance officer Arthur Chan.

dataset.title: OFSI UK Sanctions
dataset.text: The UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) imposed a civil penalty on Barclays Bank for violating financial sanctions against Syria by maintaining active trade finance accounts for businessman Maher Al-Assad.

dataset.title: FATF Grey List Case
dataset.text: Following a financial review by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), President Cyril Ramaphosa of South Africa signed new AML laws to prevent local banks like Standard Bank from handling funds associated with illicit gold networks in Zimbabwe.

dataset.title: SEC FCPA Fine
dataset.text: The SEC settled bribery charges against Swiss engineering firm ABB Ltd for violations of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) involving payments made by regional manager Marc Dufour to state officials in South Africa.

dataset.title: Venezuela OFAC Case
dataset.text: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC blocked all assets of Venezuelan shipping tycoon Nicolas Maduro Guerra, son of the president, for exploiting state oil company PDVSA to launder billions through shell companies in Switzerland and Panama.

dataset.title: German BaFin AML
dataset.text: Germany's financial watchdog BaFin ordered Deutsche Bank to implement stricter transaction monitoring controls following a probe led by regulator Christian Sewing into suspicious transfers from Russian oligarchs.

dataset.title: Iran Cargo Arrest
dataset.text: The Justice Department announced the seizure of oil aboard a Greek tanker, the Suez Rajan, owned by Suez Rajan Ltd, which was illegally transporting sanctioned Iranian crude under the direction of Greek captain Georgios Pavlidis.

dataset.title: Crypto Laundering arrest
dataset.text: Deputy Attorney General Lisa O. Monaco announced the arrest of Ilya Lichtenstein and his wife Heather Morgan for conspiring to launder 119,754 bitcoin stolen from the virtual currency exchange Bitfinex.

dataset.title: Danske Bank Denmark
dataset.text: Denmark's State Prosecutor for Serious Economic and International Crime charged former Danske Bank CEO Thomas Borgen for failing to stop suspicious transactions worth billions flowing through the bank's Estonian branch.

dataset.title: Libya Asset Seizure
dataset.text: A court in Malta ordered the seizure of €90 million in funds linked to Mutassim Gaddafi, the deceased son of former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, which were held at Bank of Valletta under fake company names.

dataset.title: UN Sanctions DRC
dataset.text: The United Nations Security Council blacklisted Willy Ngoma, a military commander of the M23 rebel group, for serious human rights violations and illegal gold mining ventures in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

dataset.title: Credit Suisse AML Fine
dataset.text: The Swiss Federal Criminal Court convicted Credit Suisse Group AG of failing to prevent money laundering by a Bulgarian cocaine trafficking ring led by former wrestler Evelin Banev.

dataset.title: SEC Ripple Case
dataset.text: The SEC filed an enforcement action against Ripple Labs Inc and its executives Brad Garlinghouse and Christian Larsen for conducting an unregistered digital asset securities offering.

dataset.title: BNP Paribas Sudan
dataset.text: The DOJ reached a plea agreement with BNP Paribas SA, where the bank pleaded guilty to processing billions of dollars on behalf of sanctioned entities in Sudan and Iran under CFO Lars Machen.

dataset.title: Nigeria Abacha Case
dataset.text: The U.S. Department of Justice returned $23 million in assets looted by former Nigerian President Sani Abacha and laundered through international financial institutions including Citibank.

dataset.title: OFAC Cuba Case
dataset.text: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC announced a settlement with Airbnb Inc for violations of sanctions against Cuba by failing to verify host identities on its platform, managed by compliance lead Sarah Johnston.

dataset.title: Madoff Securities Fraud
dataset.text: U.S. District Judge Denny Chin sentenced Bernard L. Madoff to 150 years in prison for operating a multi-billion dollar Ponzi scheme through Bernard L. Madoff Investment Securities LLC.
organizations: Bernard L. Madoff Investment Securities LLC

dataset.title: Standard Chartered sanctions
dataset.text: The New York Department of Financial Services (DFS) fined Standard Chartered Bank for hiding transactions with Iranian state institutions led by Central Bank of Iran executive Mahmoud Bahmani.

dataset.title: Goldman Sachs 1MDB
dataset.text: The DOJ announced that Goldman Sachs Group Inc agreed to pay over $2.9 billion for foreign bribery violations related to the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund, managed by financier Jho Low.

dataset.title: SEB Sweden Baltic
dataset.text: Sweden's regulator Finansinspektionen fined Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken (SEB) for compliance failures in its Baltic branches investigated by regulatory lead Erik Thedeen.

dataset.title: Eurasian Bank Money Laundering
dataset.text: The National Bank of Kazakhstan fined Eurasian Bank for failing to conduct proper customer due diligence on PEP clients under regional manager Timur Kulibaev.

dataset.title: RBS Sanctions Breaches
dataset.text: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) censured Royal Bank of Scotland (RBS) for systemic failures in screening client accounts against OFAC sanctions lists overseen by compliance director Jane Watson.

dataset.title: Malaysia Najib Razak
dataset.text: Former Prime Minister Najib Razak was sentenced to prison for money laundering and abuse of power in connection with SRC International, a subsidiary of the 1MDB fund.

dataset.title: Luckin Coffee Fraud
dataset.text: The SEC fined Luckin Coffee Inc for fabricating over $300 million in retail sales under the direction of former chief operating officer Jian Liu.

dataset.title: Westpac Australia AML
dataset.text: The Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre (AUSTRAC) ordered Westpac Banking Corporation to pay a historic fine for violating AML laws overseen by CEO Brian Hartzer.
organizations: Australian Transaction Reports and Analysis Centre

dataset.title: Danske Bank CFO case
dataset.text: Copenhagen police arrested former Danske Bank chief financial officer Jacob Aarup-Andersen for oversight failures during the money laundering investigation of the Baltic branches.

dataset.title: Equifax Data Breach AML
dataset.text: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) fined Equifax Inc for neglecting security protocols, exposing data of millions under IT security chief Susan Mauldin.
